title: A black and white photo editor
description: Work with tone, local contrast and grain, checking the result for screen or for print.

blocks.text: In a black and white frame a person needs control over tonal separation and local contrast. A ready-made preset can be a good start, but not every subject fits one setting.

quote.text: This is one of the few apps I have purchased for photo editing instead of just using the free version because especially the black and white/sepia/single and duotone color editing is best in class. The presets are so good I rarely have to manually edit when I use this app. Great textural and other light flare options also.

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result
The editor shows the overall result and lets difficult areas be fixed separately. Your own combination of settings can be saved, applied to another frame and refined before printing or posting.
Where the idea has an advantage

This scenario can be a specialized mode of an existing editor. A separate product is justified by the depth of the tonal work and a predictable export; one more set of monochrome filters is a weak difference on its own.
